text:
anna-finance: FYI vendor GreenBridge (vendor_id GB-451) sent INV-9876 dated 2025-02-05. Invoice billed VAT (\u20ac) and also a \"gross-up\" line for local withholding. PO 5120 is under Redwood Ltd (GB). Can someone confirm correct treatment?
tom-procurement: Did PO specify entity? Was vendor instructed to bill Redwood Ltd?
anna-finance: PO 5120 to Redwood Ltd (VAT GB987654321). Invoice addressed to Redwood, Inc (US). Snippet:
```Invoice INV-9876
Vendor: GreenBridge Sàrl (CH)
VAT/TVA: CH-756.1234.567 (listed)
Work: Platform integration (Jan 2025) 40h @ \u20ac200 = \u20ac8,000
Withholding gross-up: +\u20ac400 (claimed local deduction)
VAT 7.7% = \u20ac616
Total = \u20ac9,016```
paula-ops: Wait CH company charging Swiss VAT on cross-border services to a UK company sounds wrong. Also why a gross-up? That suggests vendor expects us to increase payment so their net after local withholding matches invoice. Do we have a gross-up clause in the SOW/MSA?
rachel-legal: Quick read: MSA section 4.2 states \"Supplier is responsible for its own taxes unless otherwise agreed.\" No automatic gross-up. Procurement needs to check SOW amendments. If they want gross-up, they must prove gross-up is contractually agreed.
tax-bot: Automated vendor profile check: GB-451 country=CH (Switzerland). No W-8/W-9 on file. For US tax: W-8BEN-E not applicable unless payment to US payee; W-9 only for US persons. However for withholding at source in Switzerland, Redwood typically does not gross-up unless contractually required.
anna-finance: Also invoice addressed to Redwood, Inc — we need reissue to Redwood Ltd for B2B VAT handling. Can someone flag vendor for reissue and VAT evidence?
tom-procurement: Reached out to vendor: requested corrected invoice to Redwood Ltd (GB987654321), explanation for Swiss VAT charge (are they VAT-registered in CH and why charging VAT to a UK customer), and copy of any tax treaty claim or local withholding certificate. Also asked them to remove gross-up unless they can point to signed amendment.
anna-finance: AP holding payment, tagged INV-9876 as ON_HOLD. :no_entry_sign:
rachel-legal: If vendor insists on withholding tax in CH, we need documentation of the rate and certificate proving amount withheld. If their banking/withholding rules force deduction, ask for tax voucher so Redwood can claim any applicable relief or reimbursement. But again, gross-up is a separate commercial ask.
paula-ops: Confirmed service performed for UK product team. Tom, can you ask vendor whether service was performed in CH or remotely? Location impacts VAT.
tom-procurement: Vendor replied: \"Services performed remotely by Swiss consultants. We are VAT-registered in CH and our accounting team auto-added VAT. We also withhold 5% for local social taxes and asked for gross-up to net us out.\"
anna-finance: Next steps suggested: 1) ask vendor to reissue to Redwood Ltd and remove VAT if reverse charge applies (we will share GB VAT number on PO), 2) deny gross-up unless they provide contract amendment, 3) if they withhold later, request tax vouchers/certificates, 4) request supplier tax form upload (W-8BEN-E only if needed for US reporting).
tax-bot: Note: Reverse charge between UK and Switzerland depends on local VAT rules; for services if recipient is business with VAT/UK VAT id, reverse charge may not apply straightforwardly because Switzerland is non-EU. Procurement should confirm with their accountant.
payments-bot: Payment INV-9876 flagged ON_HOLD at 2025-02-06T09:12:00Z by anna-finance.
anna-finance: Drafting vendor note: 
```Hi GreenBridge team,
Thanks for the invoice. PO 5120 is for Redwood Ltd (VAT GB987654321). Please reissue the invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd and explain why Swiss VAT was charged. Also remove any \"gross-up\" calculation unless you can supply a signed amendment to the MSA authorizing gross-up. If you intend to withhold any local taxes, please confirm the withholding authority and provide the official tax voucher/certificate showing amounts withheld. Payment will remain on hold until we receive corrected invoice and supporting docs.
Best,
Anna (Finance)```
paula-ops: Adding: please include supplier bank details and a copy of Swiss VAT registration (if charging VAT).
rachel-legal: If vendor persists on gross-up, procurement can negotiate commercial concession but legal needs to be looped. Keep audit trail.
tom-procurement: Sent to vendor 2025-02-06 09:30 CET.
anna-finance: Vendor replied 2025-02-06 11:05 CET: \"We will reissue to Redwood Ltd and remove Swiss VAT. Gross-up was internal ask, will retract unless you accept amendment.\" They attached Swiss VAT cert screenshot.
anna-finance: Marking thread for follow-up: once reissued invoice (no VAT) is in AP we can process. Closing here unless docs missing.
payments-bot: Reminder set to check AP status in 3 days.
